# Squads
A squad is a group of up to five fighters under one leader. Sergeants, lieutenants, commissars and colonels can form squads and lead people.
## How to create - An officer opens the squad console through the action bar. - In the window you can create a squad and assign fighters to open slots. - The squad's color matches the faction: gold for Imperium, dark red for Heretics.
## Traits - A squad has one leader and up to four fighters. - A squad [color=#ff0000]disbands when the leader dies[/color] — don't throw an officer under fire, people stand behind them. - A fighter can only be in one squad at a time.
## Why form a squad - Coordination in combat — you see the squad roster in the window and know who's with whom. - The squad leader is an officer who can perform [textlink="morale execution" link="WH40KMorale"] and other command abilities. - Killing an enemy officer or squad leader earns the team triple points — protect your commanders and hunt theirs.
